zh: 升级 iOS CI 自动化凭证至管理级 App Store Connect API，打通 TestFlight 自动化分发链路。
优化 Xcode 自动化导出与私钥路径装配，支持多目录兼容及自动证书分发。
持续稳固全端发布流，保持 Windows、macOS、Android 与 iOS 四端构建全量对齐。
en: Upgrade iOS CI credentials with Admin-level App Store Connect API to enable automated TestFlight distribution.
Refine xcodebuild export and private key path resolution with multi-directory compatibility for seamless provisioning.
Streamline cross-platform release pipelines to maintain synchronized builds across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS.
